name: Belmond Hotel Splendido
positioning: Splendido, A Belmond Hotel: a hillside hotel above Portofino and the Ligurian Sea, in a building that began as a Benedictine monastery
best_for: Travelers who want sea views from a hillside base above Portofino
Guests who want a Dior spa and a heated outdoor pool
Families who want a kids club and babysitting on request

facts.text: The hotel is perched above Portofino with panoramic views over the Ligurian Sea.
The building became a hotel in 1901.
The property came under Belmond's stewardship in 1985.
All guest rooms have been expanded into junior suites, standard suites or named signature suites.
Splendido Grill is a more casual poolside venue.
Baratta Sedici Bar serves cocktails and spirits.
The hotel has a heated outdoor swimming pool.
Guests have complimentary access to the tennis court, with reservations required.
The hotel's excursions include kayaking in the bay and tours to nearby Cinque Terre.
A complimentary shuttle runs to Portofino's Piazzetta.
The hotel is a 20 minute drive from Santa Margherita-Portofino train station.
A kids club and babysitting service are available on request.

highlights.text: The building was first built in the 16th century as a Benedictine monastery.
A majority of the balconied guest rooms face Portofino Bay.
The hotel offers Dior Spa Splendido and Le Jardin des Rêves Dior.
The hotel is in the middle of Parco Regionale di Portofino, a protected region.
La Terrazza serves seasonal Ligurian cuisine.

considerations.text: The hotel's season lasts from late May to early October.
Some sections of the garden require taking stairs.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive location.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Splendido, A Belmond Hotel, Portofino
